title: 第22章 绝境降临第21章 又一位
slug: 异世界开局俘虏女骑士
lines: 马可撕心裂肺的惊叫声，回荡在龙都上空。
正与米迦勒战至酣处的齐格飞，以及正和力天使纠缠的罗兰，几乎在同一瞬间停驻，齐齐回首望去。
远处街道上的烟尘滚滚散开。
女骑士残破的身躯横在狼藉街面上，整条左腿自盆骨以下不翼而飞，大量鲜血混着破碎脏器从创口中汩汩涌出，沿着倾斜的石板路不断流入一旁的下水道竖井。
“雷光？”
怎么回事？
攻击是从哪里来的？
为什么我连一点反应都没有？
各种疑问在脑海中飞快闪过。齐格飞尚未从眼前这突如其来的一幕中回过神来，一抹森白剑光便从他脖颈间掠过。
龙头飞起，思绪也戛然而止。
米迦勒挺起白金胸甲，像是终于松了口气似的，胸口微微起伏了一下。
“总算是到了。再晚些我都在想要不要主动避战来中断他的【神威】了。”
“黄金王都”昂德索雷斯，阳光大圣堂。
金色太阳高悬于穹顶之上，夺目的光华垂落而下，普照整座都城。
一道纤细曼妙的身形，自那轮金色太阳下缓步走出。其手握一杆白金大弓，洁白袍裙长长拖曳在地，裙摆拂过金砖，泛起一层细碎光尘。
腰线纤细，肩颈如玉，双腿摆动间偶尔乍现的一抹雪白，任谁看来，都会下意识将其认作一位绝代美人。
可掠过胸口、锁骨与修长脖颈后，映入眼帘的却不是人头，而是一只白金号角！
“御前七翼”次席，传说中为神明吹响启示，于洪水前警告末日，被尊称天主的喉舌——
“神任警长”加百列，历行奇兰！
一环环金黄波纹自白金号角之上荡漾开去，祂缓缓举起手中的【节制之弓】。
拉弦，搭箭。
身后六只宛若风管般的羽翼齐齐展开，汩汩吸入空气。
白金号角随之亮起，发出庄严而圣洁的声音：
「罗兰·裴迪南。」
另一边，罗兰几乎是立刻丢下“右眼”，嘶吼着朝麦克维斯的方向疾驰而去。
可他刚刚回头，耳畔便蓦然传来一声庄严的呼唤。
「罗兰·裴迪南。」
罗兰的动作顿时微微一滞。
谁？谁在喊我？
他下意识地四下张望。
“你还有空在乎别人？！”
两道炽烈金光忽然从后方直射而来。
“右眼”一转攻守，反过来冲着罗兰穷追猛打。
罗兰数次掠过雷光上空，却始终被金光逼得无法下坠救援，只能眼睁睁看着老师身下的血越流越多，只能目眦欲裂、怒吼连连。
content_en:
"Deputy Captain——!!"
Marco's heart-rending screams echoed over Longdu.
Siegfried, who was fighting with Michael to the fullest, and Roland, who was entangled with the Angel of Power, stopped almost at the same moment and both looked back.
Smoke billowed from the streets in the distance.
The mutilated body of the female knight was lying on the messy street. The entire left leg was missing from the pelvis. A large amount of blood mixed with broken organs gurgled out of the wound and continued to flow into the sewer shaft along the sloping stone road.
"Thunder light?"
What's going on?
Where did the attack come from?
Why don't I even have any reaction?
All kinds of questions flashed through my mind quickly. Before Siegfried could recover from the sudden scene in front of him, a flash of white sword light passed by his neck.
The dragon's head flew up and his thoughts stopped abruptly.
Michael straightened up his platinum breastplate, as if he finally breathed a sigh of relief, his chest rose and fell slightly.
"We're finally here. Even later, I'm still wondering whether to avoid the battle and interrupt his [divine power]."
…………
…………
"Golden Capital" Andersores, Sunshine Cathedral.
The golden sun hung high above the dome, and its dazzling brilliance fell down, illuminating the entire capital.
A slender and graceful figure slowly walked out from under the golden sun. He held a large platinum bow in his hand, and his long white robe and skirt trailed to the ground. The hem of the skirt brushed against the gold bricks, creating a layer of fine light dust.
With a slender waistline, jade-like shoulders and neck, and an occasional flash of white as her legs swing, anyone who looks at her will subconsciously recognize her as a peerless beauty.
But after passing by the chest, collarbone and slender neck, what caught the eye was not a human head, but a platinum horn!
The second seat of the "Seven Wings of the Emperor". Legend has it that he sounded revelations for the gods, warned of the doomsday before the flood, and was honored as the mouthpiece of God——
Gabriel, the "God-appointed Sheriff", travels through strange lands!
Circles of golden ripples rippled from the platinum horn, and he slowly raised the [Bow of Temperance] in his hand.
Pull the string and nock the arrow.
The six wings like air ducts behind him spread out in unison, sucking in air.
The platinum horn then lit up, emitting a solemn and holy sound:
"Roland Petinand."
"Teacher!!!"
On the other side, Roland almost immediately dropped his "right eye" and roared in the direction of McVis.
But just as he turned around, a solemn call suddenly came from his ears.
"Roland Petinand."
Roland's movements suddenly stagnated slightly.
who? Who is calling me?
He looked around subconsciously.
"Do you still have time to care about others?!"
Two blazing golden lights suddenly shot straight from behind.
"Right Eye" switched from offense to defense, and in turn pursued Roland and beat him fiercely.
Roland passed over the thunder light several times, but was always forced by the golden light and was unable to fall down for rescue. He could only watch the blood under the teacher's body flowing more and more, and could only watch with splitting eyes and roar.
